tasks.taskText: With the partial: true option (and Minimatch#match(path, true)), a path should match when it is a valid prefix of a path that the full pattern could match, including when the pattern contains **. Today patterns with a globstar wrongly report false for valid prefixes. For example minimatch("/b/c/d/a", "/**/a/b/c", { partial: true }), minimatch("/b/c/d/a", "/**/a/b/c/**", { partial: true }), minimatch("a", "a/**", { partial: true }), minimatch("/b/c/d/a", "/**/a/**/b/c/**", { partial: true }) and minimatch("/b/c/d/a", "/**/a/**", { partial: true }) must all return true, while minimatch("b/a", "a/**", { partial: true }) must still return false. Existing partial behavior for patterns without ** (for example "/a/b" against "/*/b/x/y/z" is true and "/a/b/c" is false) and makeRe(pattern, { partial: true }) must be unchanged, and non-partial matching must not loosen: minimatch("/b/c/d/a", "/**/a/b/c") stays false. Make the change in the ** path-walking logic in src/index.ts, not by post-processing results. The library is TypeScript built with npx tshy; tests run with npm test (tap, which requires 100% coverage).
